faq.a: Khazanah is associated with Arabic. Khazanah is Arabic خِزَانَة (Khizāna) 'treasure, hoard', from the root خ ز ن (kh-z-n). The source gloss 'Treasure' is consistent.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Khazanah, khazanah. Script forms are خزانة, خزانه, خزانہ, ख़ज़ाना.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
